strategies.instructions: Enable the official MCP Server integration on the selected Home Assistant instance. It exposes /api/mcp using Streamable HTTP. Choose exposed entities and confirm control permissions. OAuth supports URL-based client identity; clients that require RFC 7591 dynamic registration need another compatible route. A protected long-lived token is an alternative. Preserve separate authority for physical effects.
